component.name: LiveTVGuide
component.script:
sub init() m.rows = m.top.findNode("rows") m.timeLabelsGroup = m.top.findNode("timeLabelsGroup") m.nowPlayingTimer = m.top.findNode("nowPlayingTimer") m.detailPoster = m.top.findNode("detailPoster") m.detailTitle = m.top.findNode("detailTitle") m.detailTime = m.top.findNode("detailTime") m.detailDescription = m.top.findNode("detailDescription") m.bgAudio = m.top.findNode("bgAudio")
setupBackgroundAudio()
m.top.observeField("content", "onContentChanged") m.top.observeField("focusRequested", "focusGuide") m.top.observeField("visible", "onVisibilityChanged") m.nowPlayingTimer.observeField("fire", "onNowPlayingTimer")
m.channelIndex = 0 m.selectedSlotIndex = 0 m.poolStartSlot = 0 m.scrollStartSlot = 0 m.rowHeight = 150 m.channelWidth = 533 m.slotWidth = 320 m.visibleSlotCount = 5 m.windowSlotCount = 12 m.totalSlotCount = 48 m.channelPageSize = 4 m.detailDescriptionViewportHeight = 220 m.detailDescriptionScrollStep = 4 m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset = 0 m.detailContentKey = "" m.defaultFocusColor = "#00FF00" m.nowPlayingColor = "#FFD54A"
m.rowNodes = [] m.programGroups = [] m.programTiles = [] m.channelTimelines = [] m.timeLabelTiles = [] m.activeFocus = invalid
onVisibilityChanged() end sub
sub setupBackgroundAudio() audioContent = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") audioPath = appInfo.getValue("bg_audio_path")
' Fall back to a default local path if missing or blank if audioPath = invalid or audioPath = "" audioPath = "pkg:/bg_music.mp3" end if
audioContent.url = audioPath m.bgAudio.content = audioContent m.bgAudio.control = "preloader" end sub
sub onVisibilityChanged() if m.top.visible m.nowPlayingTimer.control = "start" if m.bgAudio <> invalid and m.bgAudio.content <> invalid m.bgAudio.control = "play" end if else m.nowPlayingTimer.control = "stop" if m.bgAudio <> invalid m.bgAudio.control = "pause" end if end if end sub
sub onContentChanged() calculateWindowStartTime() m.channelIndex = 0 m.selectedSlotIndex = 0 m.poolStartSlot = 0 m.scrollStartSlot = 0 m.detailContentKey = "" buildTimeHeader() buildRows() updateFocus() end sub
sub calculateWindowStartTime() dt = createObject("roDateTime") dt.mark()
utcSecs = dt.asSeconds() localSecs = utcSecs - (dt.getTimeZoneOffset() * 60) secondsIntoBlock = localSecs mod 1800 m.windowStartSeconds = utcSecs - secondsIntoBlock end sub
sub buildTimeHeader() while m.timeLabelsGroup.getChildCount() > 0 m.timeLabelsGroup.removeChildIndex(0) end while
m.timeLabelTiles = [] for i = 0 to m.windowSlotCount - 1 lbl = createObject("roSGNode", "Label") lbl.width = m.slotWidth - 20 lbl.height = 30 lbl.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" lbl.color = "#9DB0C3" m.timeLabelsGroup.appendChild(lbl)
line = createObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") line.width = 1 line.height = 50 line.color = "#2A3A4E" m.timeLabelsGroup.appendChild(line)
headerTile = { label: lbl, line: line, slotIndex: i } bindTimeLabel(headerTile, i) m.timeLabelTiles.push(headerTile) end for end sub
sub buildRows() while m.rows.getChildCount() > 0 m.rows.removeChildIndex(0) end while
m.rowNodes = [] m.programGroups = [] m.programTiles = [] m.channelTimelines = [] m.activeFocus = invalid
if m.top.content = invalid then return
for channelIndex = 0 to m.top.content.getChildCount() - 1 channel = m.top.content.getChild(channelIndex) row = createObject("roSGNode", "Group") row.translation = [0, channelIndex * m.rowHeight]
programsGroup = createObject("roSGNode", "Group") programsGroup.translation = [m.channelWidth, 0] row.appendChild(programsGroup)
channelTiles = []
timeline = normalizeChannelTimeline(channel) m.channelTimelines.push(timeline)
for slotIndex = 0 to m.windowSlotCount - 1 tileResult = createProgramTile(m.slotWidth) programsGroup.appendChild(tileResult.tile) bindProgramTile(tileResult, channelIndex, slotIndex) channelTiles.push(tileResult) end for
appendChannelCard(row, channel)
m.rows.appendChild(row) m.rowNodes.push(row) m.programGroups.push(programsGroup) m.programTiles.push(channelTiles) end for end sub
function normalizeChannelTimeline(channel as object) as object normalized = [] currentTime = m.windowStartSeconds maxTime = m.windowStartSeconds + (m.totalSlotCount * 1800)
if channel = invalid then return normalized
offAirUrl = "" if channel.hasField("program_offair") and channel.program_offair <> invalid offAirUrl = channel.program_offair end if
numChildren = channel.getChildCount() if numChildren = 0 normalized.push(createOffAirItem(currentTime, maxTime - currentTime, offAirUrl)) return normalized end if
firstProgramStart = -1 cycleEnd = -1 for i = 0 to numChildren - 1 prog = channel.getChild(i) if prog <> invalid progStart = currentTime if prog.hasField("startTimeSeconds") and prog.startTimeSeconds <> invalid and prog.startTimeSeconds > 0 progStart = prog.startTimeSeconds end if
progDuration = 1800 if prog.hasField("durationSeconds") and prog.durationSeconds <> invalid and prog.durationSeconds > 0 progDuration = prog.durationSeconds end if
if firstProgramStart < 0 then firstProgramStart = progStart progEnd = progStart + progDuration if progEnd > cycleEnd then cycleEnd = progEnd
if progStart > currentTime gapDuration = progStart - currentTime normalized.push(createOffAirItem(currentTime, gapDuration, offAirUrl)) currentTime = progStart end if
if (progStart + progDuration) > m.windowStartSeconds and progStart < maxTime normalized.push(createProgramItem(prog, progStart, progDuration)) if progEnd > currentTime then currentTime = progEnd end if end if
if currentTime >= maxTime then exit for end for
if channelPlaylistLoops(channel) and firstProgramStart >= 0 and cycleEnd > firstProgramStart cycleDuration = cycleEnd - firstProgramStart cycleOffset = cycleDuration
while currentTime < maxTime for i = 0 to numChildren - 1 prog = channel.getChild(i) if prog <> invalid progStart = firstProgramStart if prog.hasField("startTimeSeconds") and prog.startTimeSeconds <> invalid and prog.startTimeSeconds > 0 progStart = prog.startTimeSeconds end if progStart += cycleOffset
progDuration = 1800 if prog.hasField("durationSeconds") and prog.durationSeconds <> invalid and prog.durationSeconds > 0 progDuration = prog.durationSeconds end if
if progStart > currentTime normalized.push(createOffAirItem(currentTime, progStart - currentTime, offAirUrl)) currentTime = progStart end if
progEnd = progStart + progDuration if progEnd > m.windowStartSeconds and progStart < maxTime normalized.push(createProgramItem(prog, progStart, progDuration)) if progEnd > currentTime then currentTime = progEnd end if end if
if currentTime >= maxTime then exit for end for cycleOffset += cycleDuration end while end if
if currentTime < maxTime normalized.push(createOffAirItem(currentTime, maxTime - currentTime, offAirUrl)) end if
return normalized end function
function channelPlaylistLoops(channel as object) as boolean if channel = invalid or channel.getChildCount() = 0 then return false lastProgram = channel.getChild(channel.getChildCount() - 1) if lastProgram = invalid then return false if not lastProgram.hasField("lastItemInPlaylist") or lastProgram.lastItemInPlaylist <> true then return false if not lastProgram.hasField("nextProgram") or lastProgram.nextProgram = invalid then return false return lastProgram.nextProgram <> "" end function
function createProgramItem(prog as object, startTime as integer, duration as integer) as object progTitle = "Program" if prog.hasField("title") and prog.title <> invalid then progTitle = prog.title
progDesc = "" if prog.hasField("description") and prog.description <> invalid then progDesc = prog.description
progPoster = "" if prog.hasField("HDPosterUrl") and prog.HDPosterUrl <> invalid then progPoster = prog.HDPosterUrl
progManifest = "" if prog.hasField("manifestUrl") and prog.manifestUrl <> invalid then progManifest = prog.manifestUrl
return { title: progTitle, description: progDesc, HDPosterUrl: progPoster, startTimeSeconds: startTime, durationSeconds: duration, startTimeText: formatSlotTime(startTime), isOffAir: false, manifestUrl: progManifest } end function
function findTimelineItemAtTime(channelIdx as integer, targetSeconds as integer) as object if channelIdx < 0 or channelIdx >= m.channelTimelines.count() then return invalid timeline = m.channelTimelines[channelIdx] for each item in timeline if targetSeconds >= item.startTimeSeconds and targetSeconds < (item.startTimeSeconds + item.durationSeconds) return item end if end for return invalid end function
sub bindTimeLabel(headerTile as object, slotIndex as integer) xPos = slotIndex * m.slotWidth headerTile.slotIndex = slotIndex headerTile.label.translation = [xPos + 10, 10] headerTile.label.text = formatSlotTime(m.windowStartSeconds + (slotIndex * 1800)) headerTile.line.translation = [xPos, 0] end sub
sub bindProgramTile(tileRecord as object, channelIdx as integer, slotIndex as integer) targetTime = selectedTargetTime( m.windowStartSeconds, slotIndex, currentUtcSeconds() ) item = findTimelineItemAtTime(channelIdx, targetTime) if item = invalid item = createOffAirItem( m.windowStartSeconds + (slotIndex * 1800), 1800, "" ) end if
tileRecord.slotIndex = slotIndex tileRecord.item = item tileRecord.tile.translation = [slotIndex * m.slotWidth, 0] tileRecord.bg.width = m.slotWidth - 2 tileRecord.label.width = m.slotWidth - 20 tileRecord.timeLabel.width = m.slotWidth - 20 tileRecord.label.text = item.title tileRecord.timeLabel.text = item.startTimeText if item.isOffAir tileRecord.bg.color = "#121A24" tileRecord.label.color = "#5C6F84" else tileRecord.bg.color = "#202E3D" tileRecord.label.color = "#FFFFFF" end if end sub
sub recycleWindowForSelection() while m.selectedSlotIndex >= m.poolStartSlot + m.windowSlotCount expiredSlot = m.poolStartSlot replacementSlot = m.poolStartSlot + m.windowSlotCount recycleSlot(expiredSlot, replacementSlot) m.poolStartSlot++ end while
while m.selectedSlotIndex < m.poolStartSlot expiredSlot = m.poolStartSlot + m.windowSlotCount - 1 replacementSlot = m.poolStartSlot - 1 recycleSlot(expiredSlot, replacementSlot) m.poolStartSlot-- end while end sub
sub recycleSlot(expiredSlot as integer, replacementSlot as integer) poolIndex = expiredSlot mod m.windowSlotCount headerTile = m.timeLabelTiles[poolIndex] bindTimeLabel(headerTile, replacementSlot)
for channelIdx = 0 to m.programTiles.count() - 1 tileRecord = m.programTiles[channelIdx][poolIndex] tileRecord.focus.opacity = 0.0 bindProgramTile(tileRecord, channelIdx, replacementSlot) end for end sub
function createOffAirItem(startTime as integer, duration as integer, offAirUrl as string) as object return { title: "Off Air", description: "This channel is currently off air.", HDPosterUrl: "", startTimeSeconds: startTime, durationSeconds: duration, startTimeText: formatSlotTime(startTime), isOffAir: true, manifestUrl: offAirUrl } end function
function createProgramTile(width as integer) as object tile = createObject("roSGNode", "Group")
bg = tile.createChild("Rectangle") bg.width = width - 2 bg.height = m.rowHeight - 4 bg.color = "#202E3D"
lbl = tile.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [10, 15] lbl.width = width - 20 lbl.height = 30 lbl.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" lbl.color = "#FFFFFF"
timeLbl = tile.createChild("Label") timeLbl.translation = [10, 50] timeLbl.width = width - 20 timeLbl.height = 25 timeLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" timeLbl.color = "#7E92A7"
focus = tile.createChild("Group") focus.opacity = 0.0 appendBorder(focus, width - 2, m.rowHeight - 4, 6, m.defaultFocusColor)
return { tile: tile, bg: bg, label: lbl, timeLabel: timeLbl, focus: focus, slotIndex: -1, item: invalid } end function
sub appendBorder(group as object, width as integer, height as integer, thickness as integer, color as string) topB = group.createChild("Rectangle") topB.width = width topB.height = thickness topB.color = color
botB = group.createChild("Rectangle") botB.translation = [0, height - thickness] botB.width = width botB.height = thickness botB.color = color
leftB = group.createChild("Rectangle") leftB.width = thickness leftB.height = height leftB.color = color
rightB = group.createChild("Rectangle") rightB.translation = [width - thickness, 0] rightB.width = thickness rightB.height = height rightB.color = color end sub
sub appendChannelCard(row as object, channel as object) card = createObject("roSGNode", "Group") card.clippingRect = [0, 0, m.channelWidth - 2, m.rowHeight - 4]
bg = card.createChild("Rectangle") bg.width = m.channelWidth - 2 bg.height = m.rowHeight - 4 bg.color = "#182331"
title = card.createChild("Label") title.translation = [18, 30] title.width = m.channelWidth - 36 title.height = 40 title.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" title.color = "#FFFFFF" if channel <> invalid and channel.hasField("title") and channel.title <> invalid title.text = channel.title end if
row.appendChild(card) end sub
sub focusGuide() m.top.setFocus(true) updateFocus() end sub
sub onNowPlayingTimer() updateFocus() end sub
sub updateFocus() if m.activeFocus <> invalid then m.activeFocus.opacity = 0.0 m.activeFocus = invalid if m.programTiles.count() = 0 then return
recycleWindowForSelection()
activeTile = findTileForSlot(m.channelIndex, m.selectedSlotIndex) if activeTile <> invalid activeTile.focus.opacity = 1.0 m.activeFocus = activeTile.focus updateProgramDetails(activeTile.item) end if
updateVerticalScroll() updateHorizontalScroll() end sub
function findTileForSlot(channelIdx as integer, slotIndex as integer) as object if channelIdx < 0 or channelIdx >= m.programTiles.count() then return invalid poolIndex = slotIndex mod m.windowSlotCount tileRecord = m.programTiles[channelIdx][poolIndex] if tileRecord.slotIndex = slotIndex then return tileRecord return invalid end function
function currentUtcSeconds() as integer current = createObject("roDateTime") current.mark() return current.asSeconds() end function
function selectedTargetTime(windowStartSeconds as integer, selectedSlotIndex as integer, nowSeconds as integer) as integer if selectedSlotIndex = 0 then return nowSeconds return windowStartSeconds + (selectedSlotIndex * 1800) + 60 end function
sub updateProgramDetails(item as object) if item = invalid then return m.detailTitle.text = item.title m.detailTime.text = item.startTimeText + " (" + formatDuration(item.durationSeconds) + ")"
detailContentKey = m.channelIndex.toStr() + "|" + m.selectedSlotIndex.toStr() + "|" + item.startTimeSeconds.toStr() if detailContentKey <> m.detailContentKey m.detailContentKey = detailContentKey m.detailDescription.text = item.description setDetailDescriptionScroll(0) end if
if item.HDPosterUrl <> "" m.detailPoster.uri = item.HDPosterUrl else m.detailPoster.uri = "pkg:/images/video_placeholder.png" end if end sub
sub updateHorizontalScroll() if m.selectedSlotIndex < m.scrollStartSlot m.scrollStartSlot = m.selectedSlotIndex else if m.selectedSlotIndex >= m.scrollStartSlot + m.visibleSlotCount m.scrollStartSlot = m.selectedSlotIndex - m.visibleSlotCount + 1 end if
targetX = m.scrollStartSlot * m.slotWidth m.timeLabelsGroup.translation = [-targetX, 0] for i = 0 to m.programGroups.count() - 1 m.programGroups[i].translation = [m.channelWidth - targetX, 0] end for end sub
sub updateVerticalScroll() firstVisible = m.channelIndex - 1 if firstVisible < 0 then firstVisible = 0 m.rows.translation = [0, -(firstVisible * m.rowHeight)] end sub
function detailDescriptionMaxScroll() as float contentBounds = m.detailDescription.boundingRect() maxScroll = contentBounds.height - m.detailDescriptionViewportHeight if maxScroll < 0 then return 0 return maxScroll end function
sub setDetailDescriptionScroll(offset as float) maxScroll = detailDescriptionMaxScroll() if offset < 0 then offset = 0 if offset > maxScroll then offset = maxScroll m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset = offset m.detailDescription.translation = [0, -offset] end sub
function scrollDetailDescription(direction as integer) as boolean maxScroll = detailDescriptionMaxScroll() if direction > 0 if m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset >= maxScroll then return false setDetailDescriptionScroll(m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset + m.detailDescriptionScrollStep) else if m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset <= 0 then return false setDetailDescriptionScroll(m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset - m.detailDescriptionScrollStep) end if return true end function
sub pageChannelRows(direction as integer) if m.rowNodes.count() = 0 then return nextChannelIndex = m.channelIndex + (direction * m.channelPageSize) if nextChannelIndex < 0 then nextChannelIndex = 0
lastChannelIndex = m.rowNodes.count() - 1 if nextChannelIndex > lastChannelIndex then nextChannelIndex = lastChannelIndex if nextChannelIndex <> m.channelIndex m.channelIndex = nextChannelIndex updateFocus() end if end sub
sub onFastForward() m.top.fastForwardPressed = true scrollDetailDescription(1) end sub
sub onFastRewind() m.top.fastRewindPressed = true scrollDetailDescription(-1) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false
if key = "fastforward" onFastForward() return true else if key = "rewind" onFastRewind() return true else if key = "up" if m.channelIndex > 0 m.channelIndex-- updateFocus() end if return true else if key = "down" if m.channelIndex + 1 < m.rowNodes.count() m.channelIndex++ updateFocus() end if return true else if key = "right" if m.selectedSlotIndex + 1 < m.totalSlotCount m.selectedSlotIndex++ updateFocus() end if return true else if key = "left" if m.selectedSlotIndex > 0 m.selectedSlotIndex-- updateFocus() else m.top.menuRequested = true end if return true else if key = "OK" activeTile = findTileForSlot(m.channelIndex, m.selectedSlotIndex) if activeTile <> invalid item = activeTile.item if not item.isOffAir m.top.channelSelected = m.channelIndex else if item.manifestUrl <> invalid and item.manifestUrl <> "" m.top.channelSelected = m.channelIndex end if end if return true end if return false end function
function formatSlotTime(seconds as integer) as string dateObj = createObject("roDateTime") dateObj.fromSeconds(seconds) dateObj.toLocalTime() hours = dateObj.getHours() mins = dateObj.getMinutes() suffix = "a" if hours >= 12 suffix = "p" if hours > 12 then hours -= 12 else if hours = 0 hours = 12 end if minStr = mins.toStr() if mins < 10 then minStr = "0" + minStr return hours.toStr() + ":" + minStr + suffix end function
function formatDuration(seconds as integer) as string mins = int(seconds / 60) hrs = int(mins / 60) remMins = mins mod 60 if hrs = 0 then return mins.toStr() + "m" if remMins = 0 then return hrs.toStr() + "h" return hrs.toStr() + "h " + remMins.toStr() + "m" end function
